headline: Recount of ballots in the City Council District 4 election, including counting teams, vote totals, and final results.
summary: Volunteers will review the recount process, roles, and ballot handling rules. Teams will then count ballots, verify vote totals, and announce the final results.
items: Review the purpose and process of the recount
Review roles, responsibilities, and team assignments
Review counting procedures and ballot handling
Answer questions before the recount begins
